what: Now packaged as the aihf CLI: a 'persistent fund' whose analysts are LLM investor agents (graham, buffett, munger, lynch, druckenmiller) plus quant models, combined by YAML mandates/strategies into paper trading and backtests with a full ledger; each analyst emits a Signal = conviction + written thesis.
use: Borrow the declarative mandate idea: a teammate's duty expressed as data (which lenses, which weights, what cadence) rather than prose, and the Signal contract (number in [-1,1] plus written reasoning) so disagreements between lenses can be shown side by side. VISION.md's org chart (analysts -> PM -> risk -> books) is a clean role vocabulary.

name: helsome/folio
needs: Desktop app, market-data provider and LLM key
what: Local-first, read-only AI investment research desktop workbench: Today page (portfolio attention items, market pulse, events), deep research producing an evidence-linked ResearchReport (stance, confidence, bull/bear points, catalysts, risks), Pi agent copilot, capability registry with skill readiness, built-in evaluation center with an 86-case benchmark.
use: Borrow its one-line positioning for the finance edition: terminals say what happened; the agent answers why it matters to you, records what you believed before, and tracks what changed. Borrow the honest states: visible data freshness, missing values shown as a dash, sample data clearly badged, partial-failure status for parallel fetches. The eval set idea (golden paths, tool failures, adversarial cases) is how to regression-test a briefing teammate.

name: LLMQuant/awesome-trading-agents
needs: nothing
what: Curated, bilingual list of LLM trading/research agents, finance MCP servers and finance skill packs, organized as Agents / MCPs / Skills with fork lineage noted.
use: Use as the standing registry for the finance edition: the 'Research / equity-research copilots', 'MCPs - market data' and 'Skills - equity research' sections list candidates to evaluate next (e.g. tradermonty/claude-trading-skills, himself65/finance-skills, RKiding/Awesome-finance-skills, wshobson/maverick-mcp). A 'what's new in finance agents' teammate could diff this list weekly.

name: Fincept-Corporation/FinceptTerminal
needs: Desktop install; own data and LLM keys
what: Native C++20/Qt6 desktop financial terminal with embedded Python analytics: equity research, portfolio, news, node editor, AI agents; the open build is AGPL-3.0 and positioned for students/hobbyists, with a closed Enterprise edition for firms.
use: Reference only: how a 'Bloomberg-like' open terminal packages modules (equity research, news, macro/geopolitics, maritime) and how it splits free vs enterprise (private datasets, point-in-time history, multi-agent research, audit logs). Useful for the finance edition's pricing/packaging thinking, not for code.

name: HuaYaoAI/FinGenius
needs: Python 3.12, LLM key
what: A-share 'Research-Battle' dual-environment multi-agent app on MCP tools: six open agents (舆情, 游资, 风控, 技术, 筹码, 大单异动) research, then debate over multiple rounds and emit an HTML report.
use: Role vocabulary specific to A-share short-term trading culture (筹码, 大单异动, 游资 reading 龙虎榜) and the two-phase 'research then battle' structure with a vote; useful when designing a debate-style section for an A-share briefing.

name: liangdabiao/Claude-Code-Stock-Deep-Research-Agent
needs: Agent with web search; no data keys
what: An 8-phase stock due-diligence framework for Claude Code with about 28 parallel research sub-agents using only web search/fetch; covers business model, industry, financial quality, governance, valuation (DCF, reverse DCF), bear case and monitoring checklist; outputs a standardized 20-file report for A/HK/US names.
use: Template for a one-off 'initiate coverage' task a teammate runs when a new name enters the watchlist: phase list, cross-validation rules (profit vs cash flow, company vs peers), and the closing 'monitoring checklist' which then becomes the teammate's recurring watch items for that name.

name: DR-lin-eng/stock-scanner
needs: Python, LLM key
what: A-share analysis system (desktop PyQt6 GUI and web) combining 25 financial indicators, technical indicators, sentiment over 100+ news/announcements/research items and LLM interpretation, with fallback to rule-based analysis when the LLM is unavailable.
use: Borrow the fixed 25-indicator checklist grouped as 盈利能力 / 偿债能力 / 营运能力 / 发展能力 / 市场表现 as a deterministic fundamentals block, and the 'degrade to rules when the model fails' behaviour for scheduled runs.

name: LeekHub/leek-fund
needs: VS Code-compatible editor
what: 韭菜盒子: VS Code-ecosystem extension showing real-time funds / stocks / futures / Binance quotes in the status bar and sidebar, fund rankings and disclosed holdings, simple cost/P&L tracking and in-IDE price alerts. Not an agent.
use: Reference for the lightest possible 'ambient' surface: quotes in a status bar that never interrupt work. Its supported asset list (A/HK/US, domestic futures, overseas funds, FX rates) shows which public quote feeds are practical for a watch table.

name: opendatalab/MinerU
needs: Python 3.10-3.14 (uv venv install), 0.8-3 GB model download; hosted precision API needs a token, lightweight agent API (<=10 MB, <=20 pages) needs none
what: Document-to-markdown/JSON parser strong on formulas, tables and Chinese layouts. v4 base install runs CPU-only (ONNX; 'basic' tier about 0.8 GB models, 2 GB RAM), with llama.cpp/Vulkan for the VLM tiers and optional NVIDIA acceleration. Ships an official agent skill (`npx skills add opendatalab/MinerU --skill mineru`) and a remote API (mineru.net, MINERU_API_KEY).
use: Default heavy parser for 年报/招股书/研报 PDFs the teammate has downloaded: `mineru parse` to Markdown with page/block locators, then write tables to CSV and cite page numbers in the briefing. Basic tier (ONNX, ~0.8 GB models, 2 GB RAM) runs on a CPU-only laptop; standard tier works on CPU/Apple Silicon via llama.cpp with 8 GB RAM. Scanned or complex pages can fall back to the mineru.net API if the user allows upload.

name: run-llama/liteparse
needs: Node only (native napi binary); LibreOffice only if converting Office files
what: Fast local PDF/Office parser (Rust core on PDFium, bundled Tesseract OCR) with a Node CLI: `npm i -g @llamaindex/liteparse`, `lit parse paper.pdf --format markdown|json --target-pages 1-5`. ~2-5 ms/page, bounding boxes, page screenshots, a complexity check to decide whether OCR is needed. No GPU, no cloud, Windows/macOS/Linux. An agent skill exists (run-llama/llamaparse-agent-skills).
use: The no-Python first pass, since Node is bundled: every downloaded 公告/年报/研报 PDF goes through liteparse for text plus page numbers; the complexity check routes only scanned or table-heavy files to MinerU/PaddleOCR. Screenshots let the teammate re-read a doubtful table page visually.

name: simonlin1212/a-stock-data
needs: Python 3.9+ with mootdx, requests, pandas, baostock etc.; no API key (iwencai excepted)
what: One self-contained SKILL.md (structured Markdown + inline Python) that maps 34 public A-share sources into 15 layers / 87 endpoints: quotes/K-line, 研报 (东财 reportapi + PDF, 新浪, 同花顺一致预期), 龙虎榜, 北向, 板块资金流, 涨停/炸板/连板池, 两融, 大宗, 解禁, 巨潮公告, 财联社电报, 华尔街见闻 7x24, 新闻联播, 互动易, 宏观利率 (社融/PMI/LPR/收益率曲线), 期货, 业绩预告/机构调研/增减持, 可转债. Zero auth except iwencai; ships a fallback table for when a source is blocked.
use: Feeds the finance teammate's morning briefing: new 公告 for the watchlist since last run, new 研报 (broker, rating, target price, PDF link) appended to 情报库.csv, new 互动易 answers and 机构调研 records as the closest A-share substitute for earnings-call transcripts.

name: docling-project/docling
needs: Python 3.10+; model downloads on first run
what: IBM/LF AI document converter (MIT): PDF layout, reading order, table structure, OCR, chart-to-table, plus native parsing of XBRL financial reports; exports Markdown/JSON; runs locally on macOS/Linux/Windows x86_64 and arm64. Companion docling-project/docling-mcp exposes it as an MCP server.
use: Alternative local parser when MinerU's licence or footprint is a problem, and the one tool found that ingests XBRL instance documents directly; via docling-mcp the teammate converts a filing and gets structured tables to save as CSV.

name: PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
needs: Python 3.9+ and paddleocr>=3.7; the official skills require a PADDLEOCR_ACCESS_TOKEN from AI Studio (hosted API); local inference needs extra engine install
what: OCR and document parsing toolkit: PP-OCRv6, PP-StructureV3 (Markdown/JSON with table-cell coordinates), PaddleOCR-VL 0.9B VLM (cross-page table merging, charts to tables). Ships official Agent Skills (skills/paddleocr-doc-parsing, paddleocr-text-recognition) and an MCP server (paddleocr-mcp) with local, AI Studio, Qianfan or self-hosted modes.
use: Scanned 公告, image-only 研报 pages and screenshots of tables: the doc-parsing skill returns Markdown with tables the teammate turns into CSV. Strongest Chinese OCR option and the hosted endpoint is a Baidu service inside China.

name: manymore13/report-cli
needs: Python 3.8+; no key
what: `report` CLI (PyPI report-cli) plus a SKILL.md for querying and downloading 东方财富 research reports: 行业研报, 个股研报, 策略, 宏观, 券商晨报, with filters (industry, stock, rating, page count) and CSV export. Sister repo manymore13/report republishes a daily-updated index (today/week/month Markdown plus per-industry CSV since 2024-01-01).
use: 研报 radar: each morning `report q -t stock -c <code>` and `report q -t morning` for new items, record title/broker/rating/date/URL in 情报库.csv, read the PDF locally and write a three-line 'what this report changes versus consensus' note with a link, not a copy.

name: VectifyAI/PageIndex
needs: Python 3.10+; an LLM API key (README examples use OpenAI)
what: Vectorless RAG: builds a hierarchical tree index of a long PDF from its layout and lets the LLM reason down the tree to the right section, returning page-traceable answers; `pip install pageindex` has a local mode using your own LLM key. Reports 98.7% on FinanceBench (their Mafin 2.5 system).
use: Question answering over 300-page 年报 or 10-K without a vector database: index once (README: about USD 0.001 per page with a small model), then answer 'where does management discuss inventory write-downs' with section and page citations. The tree-index idea is also directly reusable as a design pattern in a teammate's folder.

name: opendataloader-project/opendataloader-pdf
needs: Java 11+ runtime (not bundled); hybrid mode additionally needs Python
what: Deterministic local PDF parser (Java core, Python and Node SDKs, npm @opendataloader/pdf): Markdown, JSON with bounding boxes for every element, HTML, XY-Cut++ reading order, 0.015 s/page local mode, no GPU; optional hybrid mode routes complex pages to a docling-based backend for borderless tables and OCR.
use: Fast deterministic extraction of text-layer filings where every paragraph and table needs a bounding box for citation back to the page; same output every run, which helps deduplication and diffing between report versions.

name: anthropics/skills
needs: Python (pypdf, pdfplumber, openpyxl, pandas)
what: Anthropic's public Agent Skills repo. The pdf skill teaches pypdf + pdfplumber text/table extraction, OCR, form filling; the xlsx skill teaches openpyxl/pandas/markitdown workflows with rules such as formulas instead of hardcoded values and a source note for every hardcoded number.
use: Reference for the 'PDF table to CSV/Excel' step and for spreadsheet hygiene when a teammate maintains 信源表/情报库 or exports a comparison table; the rules (cite source per number, zero formula errors) are worth copying into MyWork's own skill.

name: datalab-to/marker
needs: Python; llama.cpp `llama-server` binary for CPU/Apple Silicon OCR
what: PDF to Markdown/JSON converter built on the surya VLM, with a `fast` mode for CPU/Apple Silicon (rf-detr layout, pdftext extraction, VLM only for bad blocks) and a `--disable_ocr` pure text-layer mode.
use: Alternative local parser for English research PDFs and 10-K exhibits when speed matters; in fast mode on a laptop it handles clean digital PDFs and repairs only garbled blocks.

name: microsoft/markitdown
needs: Python
what: Lightweight converter from PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML and images to Markdown, with a plugin system and an MCP package (markitdown-mcp on PyPI).
use: Cheap first look at non-PDF attachments (Excel 业绩快报附件, Word 调研纪要, PPT 路演材料) before deciding whether a heavier parser is needed.

name: valuesimplex/FinBERT
needs: Python transformers, or Node transformers.js for ONNX builds; model download
what: 熵简科技 FinBERT2: BERT encoders pretrained on 32B+ tokens of Chinese financial text with fine-tuned classification and retrieval models. Related checked models on Hugging Face: yiyanghkust/finbert-tone-chinese (3-class sentiment trained on ~8k analyst-report sentences, Apache-2.0), ProsusAI/finbert (English), Xenova/finbert (ONNX build for transformers.js, runs in Node).
use: Optional cheap pre-filter before DeepSeek: tag each news or 研报 sentence positive/neutral/negative and count tone shift versus the previous report, or rank hundreds of headlines so only the top ones cost LLM tokens. BERT-base models run on a laptop CPU.

name: RapidAI/RapidOCR
needs: Python 3.8+ and onnxruntime
what: PaddleOCR models converted to ONNX for fast offline OCR on Linux/Windows/macOS (`pip install rapidocr onnxruntime`), Chinese and English by default; sister projects RapidTable/TableStructureRec for table structure and RapidDoc for PDF to Markdown, all ONNX.
use: Light fully-offline OCR for scanned 公告 pages or chart screenshots on a CPU-only laptop when the user does not want documents sent to a hosted OCR API.

name: hc938456/ah-disclosure-kit
needs: Python 3.11+
what: Local Python + MCP toolkit for A-share and H-share disclosures: CNINFO-first and HKEXnews-first discovery and download of annual reports, announcements and prospectuses with identity validation, PDF ingest to pages.jsonl plus SQLite FTS, evidence packets with document id/page/period/unit, deterministic calculations and 'evidence gates' that block unsupported conclusions.
use: Closest existing implementation of the pipeline a 年报 teammate needs for dual-listed names: locate, validate, ingest, retrieve bounded page evidence, compute, then let the LLM explain; worth studying even if not shipped.

name: OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills
needs: Python standard library; browser for interactive sources
what: SenseTime's MIT skill library; sn-search-year-report finds free official annual reports only (巨潮 for A-shares, SEC EDGAR, HK, UK, Japan, bond issuers) with a standard-library Python script, and instructs the agent to drop any source behind a paywall, login wall or captcha.
use: Template for the 'official sources only' rule in a filing teammate's duty text and for its output fields: code, period, title, disclosure date, PDF URL, source name.

name: jackwener/OpenCLI
needs: Node >= 20.18.1; Browser Bridge extension for logged-in sites.
what: Node CLI that turns websites into deterministic commands and can drive the user's logged-in Chrome through a bridge extension. The tree contains finance adapters: eastmoney (announcement, kuaixun, longhu, money-flow, northbound, sectors, hot-rank, holders, etf, convertible, kline, quote), xueqiu (feed, hot, hot-stock, comments, watchlist, earnings-date, fund-holdings), sinafinance (news, rolling-news), ths/tdx hot-rank, plus bloomberg/reuters/barchart/yahoo-finance.
use: `opencli eastmoney longhu --date ...`, `opencli eastmoney announcement`, `opencli xueqiu hot` give structured JSON for 龙虎榜/公告/雪球热帖 without Python. The xueqiu adapters reuse the user's own login in real Chrome, which matches MyWork's 'user logs in by hand' rule. Also ships an adapter-author skill so a teammate can add a new site.

name: newsnext/newsnow
needs: Node (npx); a BASE_URL: the public newsnow.busiyi.world or a self-deployed instance.
what: Open-source hot-list aggregator with a simple JSON endpoint per source: https://newsnow.busiyi.world/api/s?id=<source>. Verified ids: hackernews, producthunt, github-trending-today, aihot, juejin, ithome, sspai, solidot; the source file also lists v2ex, linuxdo, 36kr, zhihu, weibo, wallstreetcn, cls, xueqiu, jin10 etc. Self-hostable on Cloudflare Pages/Vercel; also ships newsnow-mcp-server (npx) with BASE_URL configurable.
use: One call returns the current 财联社/华尔街见闻/金十/雪球/格隆汇 hot lists; the 舆情 teammate diffs them against 情报库.csv and reports only what is new since the last run. It is the upstream of TrendRadar.

name: sansan0/TrendRadar
needs: Python or Docker; depends on a newsnow instance.
what: Most-starred Chinese hot-topic monitor (Python/Docker). Collects Chinese hot lists through the newsnow API plus RSS; filters by keyword file or by a natural-language interests file (AI tags + per-item score, min_score 6, falls back to keywords on failure); re-ranks with rank 0.6 / frequency 0.3 / hotness 0.1; three push modes (daily, current, incremental = only new items); timeline.yaml schedules per weekday and time slot; pushes to 企业微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/email/ntfy/Bark/Slack/webhook; bundled MCP server (search_news, get_trending_topics, aggregate_news, read_article via Jina Reader, push to channels).
use: Not shipped; borrow the pipeline: keyword groups per teammate, 'new since last push' region, RSS dedup priority guid > url, rank/time/trajectory per item, separate regions (热榜 / 新增 / RSS / AI 分析). These map one-to-one onto 信源表 + 情报库 + change-first briefings.

name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
needs: Python 3.10+ and Node 22+; an AI subscription or a DeepSeek-type API key.
what: Local web workbench for A-share 短线复盘: 盯盘 (盘面数据, 实时动态, 昨日梯队, 盘中核验), 复盘 (五分项: 情绪/资金/题材/龙虎榜/龙头 + 依据), 资讯雷达, 个股研究, 多空辩论, 回测. Derived indicators (赚钱效应, 晋级率, 梯队断层) are computed by code; the AI only explains, and its text is citation-checked.
use: Template for the 盘后复盘同事: the five-part review, the 'yesterday's ladder as a fixed sample' table, the observation-dimension/reading-boundary table, and the rule that numbers come from code while the model only narrates. Also a model for honest gaps ('接口失败不等同于没有解禁', partial coverage labelled).

name: 富途 官方 MCP + yangzhe1991/dsh-futu-mcp
needs: Futu/moomoo account and browser OAuth; the OpenD alternative needs a local gateway program plus the Python SDK.
what: Futu's hosted MCP server (https://mcp.futunn.com/mcp, streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1) for 港股/美股/A股 quotes, portfolio and trading. dsh-futu-mcp (npm @yangzhe1991/dsh-futu-mcp, MIT) is a DeepSeek-Harness plugin that connects to it, defers authorisation until first use, stores tokens in ~/.dsh/credentials (0600) and caps scopes to read-only quote:read + trade:read by rewriting the server's advertised scopes.
use: 港美股 teammate for users with a Futu account: real-time HK/US quotes and the user's own positions (read-only) for a morning 'my holdings overnight' block. The plugin is written for the same dsh runtime MyWork is built on and already implements the read-only cap this product needs.

name: longbridge/longbridge-terminal
needs: Longbridge brokerage account + developer verification; binary install (brew/scoop/script), no Python.
what: Longbridge (长桥)'s official 'AI-native' CLI binary: quotes, depth, K-lines, options/warrants, positions, with `--format json`; OAuth login; auto-selects .cn endpoints for mainland users. Sibling official repos: longbridge/skills (13 skills covering market data, fundamentals, research, earnings, market intelligence for HK/US/A/SG; MIT) and longbridge/longbridge-mcp (hosted, OAuth 2.1, 164 tools incl. analyst ratings, calendars, IPO).
use: 港美股 read-only quote and fundamentals source for the overnight section of 盘前早报 (`longbridge quote TSLA.US NVDA.US --format json`), earnings/IPO calendars and analyst-rating changes for the 事件日历.

name: Niceck/hhxg-top-hhxg-python
needs: python3 (stdlib only, no pip); no key or registration.
what: Claude-Code-format skill (SKILL.md + scripts, Python standard library only) that fetches a ready-made A-share daily snapshot from hhxg.top: 赚钱效应, 热门题材, 连板天梯, 游资龙虎榜, 行业资金, 焦点新闻, 交易日历/解禁/业绩预告, 融资融券 7 日, 北向, 题材概念链, 董秘问答, 共振/风险预警. All scripts take --json.
use: Fastest way to a working 盘后复盘: `fetch_snapshot.py` for the day, `calendar.py` for 'is tomorrow a trading day / what unlocks next week' (gates the routine), `dongmi.py` for 董秘问答 on watchlist names.

name: hssqz/plate-rotation-skill
needs: python3 stdlib; no key.
what: A-share 板块轮动 skill: cross-checks 同花顺 (same-day burst) against 开盘啦 (persistence over N days) and labels each strong sector 真主线 / 妖板 / 接棒 / 让位. Zero-dependency Python stdlib CLI (`platerotat.py today --n 5`), installable with `npx skills add`.
use: The 板块轮动 paragraph of 盘后复盘: top sectors with a two-source agreement flag and a 10/20-day persistence check, so the briefing says 'new today' versus 'day 6 of the main line'.

name: yingmi-dev/Yingmi-MCP
needs: API key from qieman.com/mcp (reported as free); nothing local.
what: 盈米基金's official cloud-hosted MCP (streamable HTTP): 69 tools for 基金 data (净值, 业绩, 费率, 交易规则, 持仓穿透, 行业配置, Brinson 归因, 债基久期), 组合诊断/相关性/回测, 热门基金 and 基金经理观点/财经资讯 search.
use: 基金 teammate: weekly 'my funds' check (NAV change, drawdown, style drift, manager change), and fund screening tables. Covers the 基金 leg that stock-centric tools miss.

name: 东方财富 妙想 Skills
needs: 东方财富 account + API key from the App.
what: 东方财富证券's official skill set for OpenClaw-type agents (first broker to ship, 2026-03): 妙想资讯搜索, 金融数据, 智能选股, 自选股管理, 模拟组合, AI 社区; API key claimed inside the 东方财富 App (search 'skills' -> 立即领取), then a skill description is pasted into the agent.
use: Authorised 东财 news search and data for individuals (replacing scraping of the same site): the 资讯搜索 skill feeds per-stock news and 公告 lookups; 金融数据 feeds quotes/财务. Community wrappers exist (meission/eastmoney, 17 stars, MIT, opened via metadata).

name: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
needs: Python 3.12 (auto-provisioned via uv); zero-config for Reddit/HN/Polymarket/GitHub; X needs browser cookies or API key; YouTube needs yt-dlp; optional ScrapeCreators/Perplexity keys
what: Agent Skill (skills/last30days/SKILL.md + Python engine) that researches any topic over the last 30 days across Reddit, X, YouTube transcripts, HN, GitHub, arXiv, Techmeme, Digg AI-1000, Polymarket and web, scores by real engagement, and has an agent judge write one cited brief. Has discovery mode ('what's exploding in AI agents?'), --competitors, GitHub person-mode, --as-of lookback, watchlist deltas between runs, HTML output, and a doctor command.
use: On-demand deep-dive behind a briefing item ('what is the community actually saying about model X / tool Y this month'), weekly 'what's heating up' discovery pass for the AI edition, and pre-meeting person/company recaps. Its watchlist-delta mode maps onto 'what changed since last time'.

name: zarazhangrui/follow-builders
needs: Node (scripts/*.js, npm install); no API keys for reading; Telegram/Resend keys only for its own delivery (not needed in MyWork)
what: A skill whose value for us is its centrally generated data: raw JSON files regenerated daily in the repo - feed-x.json (recent posts of 26 curated AI builders: Karpathy, swyx, Boris Cherny, Amanda Askell, Sam Altman...; fetched with the official X API), feed-podcasts.json (transcripts of new episodes from 6 podcasts: Latent Space, No Priors, Training Data...), feed-blogs.json (Anthropic Engineering, Claude blog). URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zarazhangrui/follow-builders/main/feed-x.json.
use: Feeds the 'what builders said today' section of the AI daily briefing with zero keys: one HTTP GET per feed, then the teammate remixes with its own duty prompt and records tweet IDs in 情报库.csv for dedup. The prompts/ folder and default-sources.json are a ready template for a 信源表.

name: LearnPrompt/ai-news-radar
needs: Nothing for the reader skill (curl + small Python one-liner for JSON; trivially replaceable with Node). Self-hosting the pipeline needs GitHub Actions and optionally DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
what: GitHub-Actions pipeline that publishes its results as static JSON on GitHub Pages: https://learnprompt.github.io/ai-news-radar/data/latest-24h.json (curated, with per-site stats) and /data/latest-24h-all.json (all AI-related items: title, url, source, published_at, first_seen_at, score, category, summary), mirrored at news.learnprompt.pro. Ships two agent skills and docs/SOURCE_COVERAGE.md, a clear table of which source types are safe defaults (official RSS, OPML, public JSON, GitHub-generated feeds) and which are opt-in (X, WeChat, Telegram).
use: Default source for the AI edition's Chinese daily brief (daily-brief.json = 20 curated items, stories-merged.json = event storylines, source-status.json = source health). The 伯乐 skill's source-intake method is what a teammate should run before adding a row to 信源表.csv. The whole repo is forkable to run MyWork's own central feed.

name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
needs: Skills are written against Hermes tools (cronjob, web_extract, terminal) and need light adaptation to MyWork routines; arxiv is curl-only; rss-feeds/watchers scripts are Python stdlib; blogwatcher needs the blogwatcher-cli binary
what: Hermes Agent ships MIT-licensed SKILL.md bundles for monitoring: competitor-news-monitor (watch contract, source hierarchy, event dedup, materiality scoring, silent when nothing material), arxiv (curl-only arXiv API), rss-feeds (stdlib feed reader + feed discovery), watchers (poll RSS/JSON/GitHub with watermark dedup), blogwatcher (stateful feed DB with read/unread), youtube-content.

name: JimLiu/baoyu-skills

what: 21 Agent Skills in SKILL.md format with TypeScript scripts run by bun/npx. Relevant: baoyu-youtube-transcript (InnerTube API directly, falls back to yt-dlp; languages, chapters, speaker identification, caching), baoyu-url-to-markdown (Chrome CDP with adapters for X, YouTube, HN, generic; waits for the user to log in / solve CAPTCHA), baoyu-danger-x-to-markdown (reverse-engineered X API behind an explicit consent file), baoyu-wechat-summary.

name: steipete/summarize

what: Node CLI (@steipete/summarize) that extracts clean text and produces summaries from web pages, files, YouTube videos, podcasts and other audio/video; '--extract --plain' works with no API key; supports configurable LLM providers and Simplified Chinese UI.

name: vigorX777/ai-daily-digest

Output Markdown: 今日看点, 今日必读 Top 3, data overview (Mermaid charts), then items grouped in 6 categories. Works with DeepSeek via OPENAI_API_BASE.

name: draco-agent/tech-news-digest

Compatible with Claude Code and Codex.

The custom-RSS env lets rows of 信源表.csv become tools without code.

name: Aas-ee/open-webSearch

name: github/github-mcp-server

name: blazickjp/arxiv-mcp-server

name: huggingface/hf-mcp-server

what: Official Hugging Face MCP. Remote streamable-http at https://huggingface.co/mcp (HF token header or ?login OAuth), or local `npx @llmindset/hf-mcp-server` (stdio) / `-http`. Searches models, datasets, Spaces and papers, semantic doc search; tool set configurable at huggingface.co/settings/mcp.
use: 模型同事: daily 'new and trending models/datasets from tracked orgs (deepseek-ai, Qwen, meta-llama...)', HF daily papers, and model-card facts (license, params, downloads) for each release line in the briefing.

name: exa-labs/exa-mcp-server

use: Design reference for making a teammate's filtering explicit and editable: 'labels' = columns in 情报库.csv (score, category, summary, source tier), 'rules' = routines ('每天 8 点把 score>=8 且 category=模型发布 的条目发我'). Could be run as a local MCP so a teammate does semantic search over everything its feeds published in the last weeks.

name: ttttmr/Wechat2RSS
needs: Nothing for public feeds; payment for private deployment.
what: Long-running (since 2021) hosted WeChat Official Account RSS service at wechat2rss.xlab.app: 300+ public accounts free, updates within about 24 h; paid private deployment for custom accounts. BestBlogs' 375-account WeChat OPML is built on it.
use: Zero-install way to put well-known AI/tech 公众号 into 信源表.csv as plain RSS URLs (no QR login, no local service). Good default for the AI edition's starter pack; fall back to we-mp-rss only for accounts not in the public list.

name: TideDra/zotero-arxiv-daily
needs: Python (or GitHub Actions), Zotero user ID + API key, SMTP, OpenAI-compatible key.
what: Daily paper recommender (Python, usually run as a forked GitHub Action): pulls new arXiv/bioRxiv/medRxiv/chemRxiv papers, ranks them by relevance to the user's own Zotero library (recent interests weigh more), adds LLM TL;DR, resolved affiliations, PDF and code links, and emails the sorted list.
use: Pattern for the 论文情报 teammate: personalize by the user's own corpus instead of a generic rubric. In MyWork the teammate's folder can hold '我关注的论文.csv' (or a Zotero export) and rank each day's arXiv listing by similarity to it; the email layout (title, affiliations, TL;DR, PDF, code) is the per-paper card to copy.

name: yzr278892/arxiv-daily-researcher
needs: Docker on Linux, two OpenAI-compatible model configs; optional MinerU for PDF parsing.
what: Chinese paper-tracking system (Python, Docker, WebUI): arXiv new + revised papers, HF Papers, PRL/Nature/Science and custom OpenAlex journals with cross-source linking; four scoring strategies (core relevance, weighted keywords, weighted keywords with penalties, preference learning from like/dislike); a cheap LLM for scoring/translation and a strong LLM for PDF deep analysis and trend reports; Markdown/HTML reports; pushes to email, 企业微信, 钉钉, Telegram, Slack, webhook; unfinished papers stay in a queue.
use: Blueprint for a researcher-facing teammate: two-model split to keep DeepSeek cost low, explicit per-item score breakdown with pass reason, 'not interested' topics and author preferences stored in memory, weekly keyword-trend report, and a backlog queue so nothing is silently dropped when a run is capped.

name: dw-dengwei/daily-arXiv-ai-enhanced
needs: GitHub Actions or local run; OPENAI_API_KEY/BASE_URL (DeepSeek).
what: The most-starred 'daily arXiv digest' of the kind MyWork's AI edition competes with: GitHub Actions crawl chosen arXiv categories each day, DeepSeek writes Chinese summaries, GitHub Pages shows them. Siblings opened: TideDra/zotero-arxiv-daily (6k stars, AGPL-3.0, ranks new papers against the user's Zotero library and emails TL;DRs) and yzr278892/arxiv-daily-researcher (318 stars, AGPL-3.0, Chinese; interest-scoring strategies, tracks revisions, HF Papers + OpenAlex journals, trend reports).
use: Cost and format benchmark for a DeepSeek-powered 论文日报: shows that full-category daily summarization is affordable, and its per-paper structured summary fields plus keyword/author preference export can be mirrored in the teammate's memory file.

name: RSSNext/Folo
needs: Account on folo.is for sync; AI features use their models or your own key.
what: The leading open-source AI RSS reader (web, desktop, mobile), sibling of RSSHub. Features verified in README: Folo AI (ask about an article/feed/folder/everything, BYO key, connect MCP services), Timeline Summary (hundreds of entries -> one digest), AI translation and summaries, and AI Tasks that write scheduled daily/weekly briefings delivered to chat or email.
use: Primary competitor/reference for the AI edition's UX: 'timeline summary' and 'AI tasks' are the reader-centric version of a teammate routine. Use it to position MyWork (persistent teammate with memory, tables and change-first reports vs. a reader with a digest button) and to borrow the feed-discovery flow.

name: barretlee/agent-pulse
needs: Nothing to read the site; Node to run.
what: Evidence-first AI industry intelligence site (TypeScript, GitHub Pages). Every published Event separates six layers: fact, evidence (original release/paper/filing), context, impact, judgment, next signal. Pipeline: collect -> normalize -> deduplicate -> cluster -> evidence binding -> deterministic readiness gate -> narrative. Sources carry four states (catalogued/observed/active/published) with a machine-generated health report (414 catalogued, 266 healthy at last audit); aggregators may suggest candidates but cannot be the only evidence.
use: Template for the 'every item sourced' promise and for the AI-investor persona: the briefing item card = fact + primary-source link + what changed + who is affected + judgment + 'what would change this view'. The source-state and health-report idea maps to extra columns in 信源表.csv (tier, last success, consecutive failures) and a weekly source audit routine.

name: leiting-eric/DailyBrief
needs: Node 20+, one LLM key.
what: TypeScript/Node daily brief generator: 53 registered sources (26 on by default; RSS and public JSON only, no keys) across GitHub Trending, AI media (OpenAI, DeepMind, HF blog, TLDR AI, Smol AI, Latent Space), world news, finance media and communities (V2EX, LinuxDo / HN, Reddit), plus quotes for 21 tickers with SMA/RSI/MACD and an LLM market comment. Six LLM backends with DeepSeek as default (about USD 0.01-0.02 per day stated); output is one self-contained HTML file; runs via GitHub Actions or a local scheduler; REPORT_HOUR supports multiple runs per day.
use: MIT, Node-only, DeepSeek-default: the most directly reusable code base for both editions. A teammate can run `npm run sources` style registry logic against its own 信源表.csv and reuse the single-file HTML report as the 'open on phone' deliverable. The sources.config.json is a ready list of key-free endpoints.

name: chubbyguan/chubbyskills
needs: Python 3.11/3.12; yt-dlp; heavy extras (funasr, ffmpeg) only for audio transcription.
what: 14 Agent Skills + a `chubby` CLI (Python) for Chinese-channel content: Bilibili/YouTube subtitles, WeChat article capture, Douyin/Weibo/Zhihu/podcast transcription, RSS/Atom/JSON Feed and YouTube-channel subscriptions with separated discover/review/ingest steps, local Markdown vault, search, and an evidence 'brief' export (verbatim excerpts with line numbers, source and SHA-256), plus an optional knowledge-base MCP server. Explicitly does not fight anti-bot measures; documents per-platform status.
use: For the AI-content-creator persona: the teammate ingests links the user drops into the thread into its folder as Markdown with provenance, then exports a sourced brief for a topic. The platform-status table and 'manual fallback instead of evasion' stance are a good policy model for MyWork's China sources.

name: karakeep-app/karakeep
needs: Docker self-host; API key; LLM key or Ollama.
what: Self-hosted bookmark-everything app (formerly Hoarder): links, notes, images, PDFs with LLM auto-tagging and summarization (Ollama supported), full-text + semantic search, RSS auto-hoarding, rule engine, highlights, full-page archival, REST API, CLI and official agent skills.
use: The open 'Readwise-like' archive: if a user already runs Karakeep, a teammate uses its CLI/skill to save every item it cites (protects against link rot) and to search what the user has saved when writing a briefing ('you bookmarked a related paper in March'). Its tag + rule engine is a reference for the teammate's own library table.

name: dgtlmoon/changedetection.io
needs: Docker/Python if run as a service; nothing if only the pattern is borrowed.
what: Self-hosted web page change detection and alerting (Python/Docker): watches pages for content changes and notifies. Opened as the mature open reference for 'what changed since last time' on pages that are not news (pricing tables, model cards, docs, changelogs).
use: Model for a 价格/文档变更 routine: the teammate keeps a snapshot per watched URL in its folder (API pricing pages of OpenAI/Anthropic/DeepSeek/阿里云百炼, model deprecation pages), diffs on each run and reports only the changed lines with before/after. Either re-implement the diff in the teammate (simple) or call a local changedetection instance.

name: wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-sleep
needs: Nothing for the Markdown skills; some helpers call Python; the full dsh-aris bundle requires Codex CLI + python3 as an independent reviewer (not needed if only the lit skills are copied).
what: ARIS: ~82 Markdown-only SKILL.md research skills, Chinese-authored, with a dedicated DeepSeek Harness distribution branch (`dsh-aris`, installed via `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-aris`). Relevant skills: arxiv, alphaxiv, deepxiv, openalex, semantic-scholar, exa-search, research-lit, research-wiki, novelty-check, citation-audit, paper-claim-audit, feishu-notify.
use: Drop in the literature subset as-is: `/arxiv` + `/openalex` + `/semantic-scholar` for the daily sweep, `/alphaxiv` or `/deepxiv` for cheap single-paper reads, `/novelty-check` when a user asks 'is this idea new', and the 3-layer `/citation-audit` (existence -> metadata -> does the source support the claim) as the pre-send check on every briefing.

name: Companion-Inc/feynman
needs: Node only (matches MyWork's bundled runtime) for the CLI; a model provider; free OPENALEX_API_KEY / SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY recommended.
what: Open-source AI research agent CLI in TypeScript (npm `@companion-ai/feynman`, Node >=22.22) built on the Pi harness with four agents (researcher, reviewer, verifier, writer). Workflows: /deepresearch, /lit, /review, /audit (paper claims vs public code), /compare, /summarize; each writes a provenance file of sources used and what was verified. Repo contains 16 SKILL.md skills plus prompts/*.md and agent role files.
use: Closest role/prompt template for an AI-edition teammate: copy skills/literature-review, deep-research, source-comparison, paper-code-audit, pdf-explore and the four role files. `/audit` answers 'does the released code actually do what the paper claims'; `/compare` produces the source comparison matrix for model/paper head-to-heads.

name: dginev/ar5iv
needs: Nothing.
what: The primary-source layer. All answered 200 in this session: export.arxiv.org/api/query (Atom search by category/date), rss.arxiv.org/rss/{cat} (daily feed), arxiv.org/list/{cat}/new, arxiv.org/html/{id} (official LaTeXML HTML), ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/{id} (HTML for older papers), arxiv.org/src/{id} (LaTeX source tarball).
use: Row one of 信源表.csv: the 8:00 routine pulls the RSS for watched categories, dedups against 情报库.csv by arXiv ID+version, and reads shortlisted papers as HTML (section anchors, tables intact) instead of PDF; falls back to /src for exact numbers in tables and equations.

name: DeepXiv/deepxiv_sdk
needs: Python >=3.8 (`pip install deepxiv-sdk`); token auto-registered on first use; a registered key for `ask`/`talent` (300 agentic calls/day free).
what: CLI + Python SDK over a hosted service (data.rag.ac.cn) that has pre-parsed arXiv into sections. `deepxiv paper <id> --brief | --head | --section Experiment` gives layered reading; `deepxiv search` filters by date/citations/venue/org; `deepxiv ask` returns answers cited to real arXiv IDs; `deepxiv ask --web` and a `talent` people search (beta).
use: Token-cheap triage on DeepSeek: 300 tokens of TLDR to decide, then only the Experiments section to extract the benchmark numbers that go into the briefing. `deepxiv ask` answers 'what speedup does paper X report on benchmark Y' with a checkable citation.

name: OpenAlex API
needs: Free API key (strongly recommended); budget tracking via x-ratelimit-* response headers.
what: Open scholarly graph (works, authors, institutions, references, cited-by, related works) and the practical open backend for Connected-Papers-style related-work graphs. Since Feb 2026 it is key-based with usage pricing: free key = $1/day, keyless = $0.10/day, ID lookups free, list/filter $0.10 per 1k, search $1 per 1k; CC0 bulk snapshot stays free.
use: Related-work and impact context per paper: who cites it, what it builds on, the author's or lab's other recent work, a citation-count delta since the last briefing. Also the cross-check for 'does this reference exist' in the verification pass.

name: alphaXiv markdown endpoints
needs: Nothing, but a browser User-Agent header is required.
what: alphaxiv.org serves LLM-oriented markdown per arXiv ID: /overview/{id}.md (a structured analysis: authors and context, problem, method, results) and /abs/{id}.md (full paper text). Used as the quick-read tier by ARIS's alphaxiv skill and by Feynman.
use: First-pass reader for 'explain this paper' and for the one-paragraph 'what it claims / why it matters' line in briefings, before deciding whether the paper deserves a full read from arXiv HTML.

name: papers.cool (Cool Papers)
needs: Nothing.
what: 'Cool Papers - Immersive Paper Discovery': per-arXiv-category listing pages (papers.cool/arxiv/cs.CL) each with an Atom feed (/arxiv/{cat}/feed) carrying id, title, authors and abstract for the day's papers; venue listings also exist.
use: A second feed for the daily arXiv sweep (one request returns the whole day for a category) and a fallback when arxiv.org is slow.

name: bytedance/deer-flow
needs: For skills: nothing. For the product: Python 3.12 + Node 22, Docker recommended, search/crawl keys (Tavily, Jina, InfoQuest and others).
what: DeerFlow 2.0, a ground-up rewrite from a deep-research framework into a 'super agent harness' (sub-agents, sandbox, long-term memory, scheduled tasks, IM channels, skills). Ships MIT SKILL.md skills under skills/public: deep-research, systematic-literature-review, academic-paper-review, github-deep-research, newsletter-generation, consulting-analysis. README recommends Doubao, DeepSeek and Kimi models.
use: (a) Lift skills/public/deep-research, github-deep-research (for the open-source-project tracker teammate), systematic-literature-review and newsletter-generation as drop-in skills. (b) Benchmark MyWork's teammate model against its memory + scheduled-tasks + IM-gateway design.

name: jordan-gibbs/hyperresearch
needs: Python 3.11-3.14 (`pip install hyperresearch`); relies on host sub-agents and web tools.
what: Deep-research harness for Claude Code/Codex: a thin router skill plus one step-skill per phase (16 steps: decompose -> width sweep -> contradiction graph -> depth investigation -> four parallel critics -> tool-locked patcher -> cite-check gate). Every source lands in a markdown + SQLite vault reused across sessions; `hpr scholar search` unifies OpenAlex, Crossref, CORE, DOAB, ClinicalTrials.gov, SEC EDGAR and FRED; Unpaywall/Europe PMC used to get legal full text; runs resume from a manifest.
use: Method donor for a 'deep dive' routine run on request ('write me the state of agent memory research'): step-file loading to stop context rot, the independence audit (five reprints of one press release count as one source), the cite-checker gate. The vault maps directly onto the teammate's folder + 情报库. SEC EDGAR/FRED connectors also matter for the finance edition.

name: 199-biotechnologies/claude-deep-research-skill
needs: Python for the scripts; optional search-cli with Brave/Serper/Exa/Jina/Firecrawl keys.
what: Single deep-research skill with an 8-phase pipeline (scope -> plan -> retrieve -> triangulate -> outline -> synthesize -> critique with loop-back -> package) and unusually concrete machinery: JSON schemas for claim/evidence/source/run_manifest, disk-persisted sources.json, and scripts verify_citations.py (DOI/URL/hallucination check), verify_claim_support.py (deterministic entity/number/date overlap, no LLM), source_evaluator.py (credibility scoring), validate_report.py (9 checks).
use: Borrow the schemas and the cheap deterministic verification pass: before a briefing ships, every number/date/entity in a claim must appear in the stored evidence text for its cited source. Also 'Step 0: get today's date before searching', which prevents stale-year queries.

name: markrussinovich/refchecker
needs: Python >=3.11 (`pip install academic-refchecker`) or Docker; an LLM key for the hallucination pass; S2/OpenAlex keys help.
what: Validates every reference in a paper against Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Crossref, DBLP and ACL Anthology, then uses LLM web search to flag likely fabricated references. CLI, web UI, HTTP API and signed desktop builds (macOS/Windows); bulk-scans OpenReview venues; reports about $0.04 per paper.
use: Quality signal in the paper briefing ('3 of 41 references unverifiable') and, more importantly, the reference design for the teammate's own bibliography check on long reports it writes.

name: u14app/deep-research
needs: Node; DeepSeek key; a search key (Bocha/Tavily) or a SearXNG instance.
what: Next.js deep-research app that lists DeepSeek as a first-class provider and, uniquely among those I read, Bocha (博查) plus SearXNG/Tavily/Exa/Brave as search providers. Exposes itself as an SSE API (/api/sse) and as an MCP server (streamable-http at /api/mcp); local knowledge base from uploaded files.
use: If a turnkey 'deep research' tool is wanted behind the MCP connector, this is the one whose default stack (DeepSeek + Bocha) is usable from mainland China; otherwise copy its thinking-model/task-model split and report flow.

name: dzhng/deep-research
needs: Node; Firecrawl key (or self-hosted Firecrawl) if run as code; nothing if only the method is reused.
what: The minimal reference implementation (<500 LoC TypeScript) of recursive deep research: generate SERP queries -> process results into learnings + new directions -> recurse while depth > 0 with breadth/depth parameters -> markdown report. Works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OPENAI_ENDPOINT/OPENAI_MODEL).
use: Encode the breadth x depth loop as a ~1-page SKILL.md the teammate executes with its own web search and browser; breadth/depth become user-visible knobs ('quick look' vs 'deep dive'). The accumulated-learnings list is the natural append target for memory.

name: jina-ai/node-DeepResearch
needs: Node; Jina API key (free tier) + an LLM key if run as code.
what: TypeScript 'DeepSearch': loop search -> read -> reason until the answer is found or a token budget is exceeded; explicitly optimises for correct short answers, not long reports. Uses Jina Reader for search/reading and Gemini/OpenAI/local LLMs. Two-part implementation guide available in English and Chinese.
use: Method for the Q&A side of a teammate ('which providers support X today?', 'what is the current price of model Y?'): keep searching/reading under an explicit token budget and stop when evidence suffices. The budget idea suits DeepSeek cost control.

name: Socialpranker/deepdive
needs: Nothing (Markdown); assumes sub-agents and per-phase model routing that must be flattened for DeepSeek.
what: Claude Code skill running a 13-phase research pipeline with a plan-review gate before any search fires, a claims ledger with triangulation, a verify phase, and source scoring that adds strict caveat markers when a source measures its own product, self-reports a benchmark, or is disputed by another collected source. README says the methodology is portable to any LLM by loading SKILL.md + references/*.md.
use: The caveat taxonomy is what the AI edition needs for model releases: tag every benchmark number in a briefing as vendor-self-reported vs independently reproduced, and show disputes. The claims ledger becomes a table the teammate maintains.

name: Future-House/paper-qa
needs: Python >=3.11; an LLM key and an embedding model (defaults to OpenAI embeddings; local sentence-transformers supported).
what: PaperQA2: high-accuracy RAG over a local folder of papers with in-text citations; `pqa ask '...'` CLI; fetches metadata from Semantic Scholar/Crossref/Unpaywall including citation counts and a retraction check; LiteLLM for any model; optional Docling PDF reader.
use: Question-answering over the teammate's own folder of saved papers ('across the 60 papers I filed this quarter, which report results on SWE-bench Verified?') with page-level citations, and the retraction/citation-count metadata check on items before they are reported.

name: assafelovic/gpt-researcher
needs: Python >=3.12; LLM key (OpenAI-compatible base URL supported) + Tavily key by default.
what: The longest-running open deep-research agent: planner generates research questions, execution agents crawl and summarise each with source tracking, publisher aggregates into a cited report. pip package, web UI, MCP client support (hybrid web + MCP retrievers), and installable as a skill (`npx skills add assafelovic/gpt-researcher`). Chinese README.
use: Reference for the planner/executor/publisher split and per-source summarise-then-filter step; could be called as a Python CLI for a one-off long report, but for a persistent teammate the method is worth more than the code.

name: xAI X Search tool (x_search)
needs: User's own xAI API key (paid). Works over plain HTTPS from Node.
what: Official server-side tool of the xAI API: Grok searches X and returns an answer with citations to post URLs. Parameters: allowed_x_handles / excluded_x_handles (max 20 each), from_date / to_date (YYYY-MM-DD), image/video understanding. Billed $5 per 1k posts fetched and $10 per 1k profiles, plus tokens (grok-4.7: $2/M in, $6/M out).
use: The only licensed, key-only way to answer 'what did these 20 AI researchers post since yesterday / what is X saying about model Y' without cookies or scraping. A teammate calls it once per watchlist batch with from_date = last run date and stores the cited post URLs in 情报库.csv.

name: X API v2 (official, pay-per-usage)
needs: X developer account + prepaid credits (user's own key).
what: X's official API is now credit-based pay-per-use with no subscription: $0.005 per post read, $0.010 per user read, 'owned reads' $0.001; cap 3M post reads/month; no free tier.
use: Deterministic timeline polling for a fixed watchlist (e.g. 50 AI accounts x ~10 posts/day = ~$2.5/day) when the user wants exact, complete, non-LLM-mediated posts; also the backend a first-party MyWork feed service would use.

name: HackerNews/API
needs: Nothing.
what: Official keyless HN JSON API (hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0, 'currently no rate limit'), Algolia full-text search (hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search_by_date with query/tags/points filters) and hnrss.org keyword/points feeds.
use: Daily 'HN 上的 AI 讨论': query Algolia for stories since last run with points>100 matching the teammate's keyword table (LLM, agent, model names), pull top comments by item id, dedupe by objectID. No login, no key - safe to ship built in.

name: yt-dlp/yt-dlp
needs: Standalone binary + JS runtime (bundled Node can serve) + ffmpeg for audio; proxy for YouTube in mainland.
what: The standard audio/video/subtitle extractor. Ships standalone binaries (yt-dlp.exe, yt-dlp_macos) so no Python install is needed; YouTube now additionally requires yt-dlp-ejs and a JS runtime (deno recommended; node/bun accepted).
use: For a 视频/播客速记员 teammate: `--write-auto-subs --skip-download` to get captions of a new YouTube upload, or `-x` to pull podcast audio for local ASR. Pair with the keyless channel feed youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=... (200 in this session) to detect new uploads.

name: k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx
needs: Node addon + model download (hundreds of MB; ModelScope mirrors exist in README links).
what: Offline speech toolkit on onnxruntime: ASR with SenseVoice (zh/en/ja/ko/yue), Paraformer, Whisper, Zipformer; VAD; speaker diarization. Has Node.js bindings on npm (sherpa-onnx-node 1.13.8, 2026-09-10) and runs on Windows/macOS.
use: Local transcription of podcasts / B站 / 小宇宙 audio with no Python and no cloud: bundled Node calls sherpa-onnx-node with a SenseVoice model for Chinese and Whisper for English, with VAD segmentation and speaker labels, then the teammate summarises. Fits the 'runs on the user's own computer' promise.

name: ggml-org/whisper.cpp
needs: Compiled binary per platform + ggml model file (HF-hosted; use hf-mirror/ModelScope in mainland) + ffmpeg.
what: C/C++ port of Whisper (formerly ggerganov/whisper.cpp): Metal/Core ML on Apple Silicon, MSVC builds on Windows, quantized models, built-in VAD, large-v3-turbo. Release v1.9.4 on 2026-09-11.
use: English podcast / YouTube-without-captions transcription on the user's machine via a bundled CLI binary; pairs with yt-dlp audio extraction and ffmpeg resampling to 16 kHz.

name: modelscope/FunASR
needs: Python + torch (install step), models from ModelScope.
what: Alibaba's ASR toolkit: Paraformer/SenseVoice models, VAD, punctuation, CAM++ speaker segments; README advertises an MCP server example and an OpenAI-compatible serving example. SenseVoice repo (now QwenAudio/SenseVoice, MIT, 9.4k stars, pushed 2026-09-30) is the multilingual small model.
use: Best-quality Chinese transcription for 小宇宙 / B站 / 抖音 talks when the user is willing to install Python; or run its OpenAI-compatible server once and let teammates POST audio to localhost.

name: weisi-gu/xiaoyuzhou-podcast-notes
needs: Python, DASHSCOPE_API_KEY (mainland region for free quota).
what: SKILL.md skill that turns a 小宇宙 episode into structured Markdown notes: uses the page's official transcript when present, else Aliyun DashScope ASR (paraformer-v2 at 0.00008 CNY/s with 10 h free per month; fun-asr / qwen3-asr-flash at 0.00022 CNY/s), with diarization, hot-word vocabulary and --fallback chain; ships example outputs.
use: Chinese AI podcast coverage (e.g. weekly '本周 AI 播客要点'): teammate watches show feeds, runs the skill on new episodes, stores notes with speaker-attributed quotes. The cost table gives a concrete cloud-ASR alternative for users who cannot run local models (a 90-minute episode ~0.43 CNY).

name: xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp
needs: User scans QR to log in with their own 小红书 account; Go binary or Docker.
what: Go MCP server for xiaohongshu.com: login/check login, search, read notes and comments, feeds, publish image/video notes. Listens on localhost:18060 (last30days auto-probes it). Sister project xpzouying/x-mcp is a Chrome-extension variant that reuses the user's browser login but routes through the aredink.com token service (no licence).
use: 中文社区观察员: search 小红书 for 'AI 工具/某模型 体验' and read top notes + comments to report real user sentiment on AI products (useful for AI PMs and content creators). Use read tools only.

name: zhengjy01/dsh-jike
needs: User scans a QR code with the 即刻 app; tokens stored locally (0600).
what: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin, npm @zhengjunyao/dsh-jike (MIT, Node >= 22.19): self-contained 即刻 web-API client exposed as jike_* agent tools - QR login from a settings card, following feed, post detail, user posts, search, topic feeds, notifications; write actions exist but sit behind a read-only switch that is on by default. Alternative opened: MidnightDarling/jike-skill (16 stars, MIT, Python pip).
use: 即刻 is where many Chinese AI builders post first: teammate reads the user's following feed and chosen 圈子/topics each morning and reports new posts with links. Built for the same harness MyWork runs on (requires DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.1), so it is the most direct fit of anything found.

name: chigwell/telegram-mcp
needs: Python 3.10+, TELEGRAM_API_ID/API_HASH from my.telegram.org and a session string (full account access).
what: Telethon-based Telegram MCP server: list chats, get_history, search_messages/search_global, message context, optional voice transcription (faster-whisper/Groq), incoming feed to JSONL; many write tools too. Keyless alternative verified: public channels have a web preview at t.me/s/<channel> (200 here) and RSSHub has /telegram/channel.
use: Read the AI/crypto/finance Telegram channels the user already follows and summarise new messages since last run; for public channels prefer the t.me/s preview page (no account).

name: Rishikant181/Rettiwt-API
needs: Node 22/24; optionally the user's X cookies.
what: Unofficial X clients using X's internal web API. Rettiwt-API: TypeScript/Node 22+, CLI + library, guest mode (tweet details, user details, user timeline) or cookie login (search, lists, replies). twscrape: Python, account pool with rotation, cookies auth_token+ct0, optional curl-cffi TLS impersonation (MIT, 2.8k, pushed 2026-09-22). twitter-cli: Python, cookie auth with TLS fingerprint impersonation and timing jitter (Apache-2.0, 3.0k, pushed 2026-05).
use: Only as a user-installed, user-risk fallback for reading a handful of timelines when the user refuses to pay for x_search / X API; Rettiwt guest mode (no account) is the least risky variant and runs on bundled Node.

name: NanmiCoder/MediaCrawler
needs: Python, Playwright or Chrome CDP, user logins.
what: Playwright/CDP crawler for 小红书, 抖音, 快手, B站, 微博, 贴吧, 知乎 (posts + comments) that reuses the user's logged-in Chrome. Licence is a custom 'NON-COMMERCIAL LEARNING LICENSE 1.1': learning/research only, no large-scale crawling, no commercial use without the author's written consent.
use: None inside the product. Useful only as a reference for how CDP-attached login reuse works and as a warning: its README links a list of crawler criminal cases in China.

name: zedeus/nitter
what: Status check: the alternative X front-end received cease-and-desist letters from X Corp. on 2026-08-24; the repo is archived on GitHub, README says the project 'will continue' after legal advice; public instances went dark and some (xcancel) returned in September. RSS is instance-specific and 'often disabled due to abuse'.
use: None - do not build a routine on Nitter instances or on skills that scrape them (e.g. swyxio/skills twitter-x-scraping, which also bypasses anti-bot challenges).

name: Nemo2011/bilibili-api
what: Status check: both cornerstone Bilibili reverse-API projects are dead. bilibili-api's README is now the lawyer's letter from Bilibili dated 2026-07-06 (reverse engineering of non-public interfaces, auth and anti-crawl signatures; unfair competition) and the repo is archived; bilibili-API-collect (20k stars) was archived after a similar letter in January 2026.
use: None. For B站 use only: the user's own browser (OpenCLI bilibili adapter / generic Chrome reading), RSSHub locally, or audio -> local ASR. Do not bundle any Bilibili API wrapper; several MCP servers and bilibili-cli were built on these libraries.

name: agentskills/agentskills
needs: nothing
what: The open Agent Skills specification (originated at Anthropic). A skill is a folder with SKILL.md: required frontmatter name (max 64 chars, lowercase/hyphen, must equal the folder name) and description (max 1024), optional license, compatibility, metadata, allowed-tools (experimental); optional scripts/, references/, assets/; loaded by progressive disclosure.
use: Not used by a teammate directly. It is the contract MyWork's bundled and user-added skills must satisfy so the same folder works in dsh (.agents/skills), Codex, Claude Code and OpenClaw. Use the license and compatibility fields to show origin and 'needs Python' on the teammate's skill card.

name: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin
needs: dsh web 0.1.0-rc.6 or newer; pnpm for source builds
what: The DeepSeek Harness plugin catalog (plugins.json, 4,412 entries on 2026-10-01, 23 categories, 175 in 'skill') and the in-app market plugin (`dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket`). Each entry carries npm name, 30-day downloads, a static capability scan (fs-read/write, env, network, shell, credentials, dynamic-code) and 'capabilityRedLines'.
use: The native source for anything that must be a dsh plugin, not a plain skill. Finance: PerryLink/dsh-industry-research, PerryLink/dsh-fund-research, tiantianlaolao/dsh-astock-research, Realyujie/dsh-us-stocks, JohnXu22786/market-watch. AI news: hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#rss, STARDUSTLC666/dsh-rss, shangjian2023/dsh-rss-daily, literaf/dsh-ai4scholar, anweat/dsh-web-search-pro. Filter the catalog by capability before offering anything to a teammate.

name: PerryLink/dsh-industry-research
needs: dsh with peers >=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0; Node 22.19+; no API key
what: Native dsh domain pack: industry_map (chain.json, every metric value must carry a sourceRef), industry_track (public policy/news tracking through ctx.web with SHA-256 snapshot hashes, appended and deduped into timeline.jsonl), company_scan (company cards citing file and line), industry_report (deterministic delivery checks, bull/bear synthesis), a versions.jsonl ledger and two methodology skills. Sibling dsh-fund-research does Chinese public mutual funds from 天天基金/东方财富 public data.
use: Closest existing implementation of MyWork's promise on the same harness: an 行业跟踪 teammate runs industry_track on its topics every morning, appends only new items to the timeline and reports the delta. Borrow the file formats for 信源表 and 情报库.

name: KKKKhazix/khazix-skills
needs: nothing for aihot
what: Six skills by 数字生命卡兹克. aihot queries aihot.news (daily Chinese AI report and all AI items, no API key); hv-analysis (横纵分析法) produces a long research report on a product, company or concept; leader turns a vague request into a goal brief.
use: AI edition: aihot is a one-call Chinese AI-news source to cross-check the teammate's own findings; hv-analysis is the on-demand deep dive when the user asks about one company or product.

name: NVIDIA/SkillSpector
needs: Python 3.12+ (uv) or Docker; LLM stage needs an API key
what: Security scanner for agent skills: 71 patterns in 17 categories (prompt injection, data exfiltration, supply chain, trigger abuse, dangerous code via AST, taint tracking, YARA, MCP tool poisoning), static stage plus optional LLM stage, JSON/Markdown/SARIF output, 0-100 risk score, baselines. Scans git repos, URLs, zips or folders.
use: Not a teammate skill. Run it (static mode, --no-llm) in MyWork's build pipeline on every bundled skill at its pinned commit, and optionally on a user-added skill before enabling it.

name: snyk/agent-scan
needs: Snyk account and SNYK_TOKEN; uvx or binary
what: Snyk's scanner that discovers installed agents, MCP servers and skills on a machine and checks them for prompt injection, sensitive-data handling and malware payloads hidden in natural language. Ships as a uvx package or standalone binary; the repo holds Snyk's skills threat report (ToxicSkills).
use: Second scanner for the bundled-skill review, and the source of the threat model: Snyk's Feb 2026 audit of 3,984 skills from ClawHub and skills.sh found 36.82% with a flaw, 13.4% critical, 76 confirmed malicious payloads.

name: openclaw/clawhub
needs: clawhub CLI; GitHub login to publish
what: OpenClaw's public skill and plugin registry (publish, version, vector search, `clawhub install`). Skills declare runtime needs under metadata.openclaw (requires.env, requires.bins, install specs); each release gets an audit status (Pass / Review / Warn / Malicious) and a risk level; reports and moderation holds exist.
use: Mainly a cautionary reference and a metadata model: copy the 'declared env vars and binaries must match what the skill actually uses' check. Do not let teammates install from it unvetted.

name: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
needs: Claude Code for direct install
what: Anthropic's curated plugin directory (315 entries in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json). Defines the plugin layout: .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .mcp.json, commands/, agents/, skills/; supports 'skill-bundle plugins' that point at a repo of SKILL.md files with strict:false and an explicit skills array; plugin names are immutable slugs with a renames map.
use: Reference for packaging a MyWork teammate template (duty + skills + connectors + routines) and for a catalog format with immutable ids. Finance-related entries exist (bigdata-com, blackrock-advisor-center-plugin, carta-investors, chronograph).
